# Allure Modelling

Talent marketplace for **models**, **influencers**, **artists**, and **photographers**.

Allure Modelling is a separate product from [Allure Agency](https://allureagencys.com) (casting / talent). People can hold both identities; switching hands them between sites.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Website** | [alluremodeling.com](https://alluremodeling.com) |
| **Staging** | [front-staging.alluremodeling.com](https://front-staging.alluremodeling.com) |
| **Agency (casting)** | [allureagencys.com](https://www.allureagencys.com) |

## Product scope

- Public modeling directory (model · influencer · artist · photographer)
- Professional identity profiles, portfolios, and twin/model appearance data
- Admin approval for modeling identities (independent of casting approval)
- Shared person account with Agency, separate public site and brand

## Repositories

This organization will hold Allure Modelling application code. Modeling work previously started on a branch inside the Agency backend will live here as its own project.
